name: IRAS GST F5 return boxes

verification.notes: Box numbers and names copied from the IRAS Completing GST Return page. Boxes 18-21 (IGDS) are described on that page as a section for IGDS-approved businesses only and are not listed here as individual codes.

notes: IRAS publishes F5 box numbers, not separate transaction codes. Accounting-software tax codes such as SR, ZR, ES33, and TX come from the IRAS Accounting Software Register Plus (ASR+) / IAF specification and were not verified in the source research; they are not included.
